objective: Migrate ONLY the "Creador de cotizaciones" feature (including its embedded Proveedores management, not as a separate section) of NeoArts-WebTools to a focused web app, preserving required behavior, data semantics, and interface familiarity. Other legacy features are out of scope. No sidebar unless needed.
target_stack: Vite 5 + React 18.3 + TypeScript 5.5 + Tailwind CSS 3.4 (@tailwindcss/forms); jsPDF 2.5.1 + jspdf-autotable 3.8.2; xlsx 0.18.5; file-saver; react-hot-toast 2.6.0. Static SPA, browser storage only.
target_architecture: Single static page; hash routes #/ and #/cotizacion/<id>; IndexedDB QuotesDB v1 (quotes) + localStorage providers/currentQuote, schema identical to legacy; PDF engine copied from legacy and lazy-loaded.
migration_strategy: rehearsed replacement of one feature; legacy left untouched; same-origin storage compatibility enables zero-copy data continuity
constraints: Only the quote creator + embedded providers (user)

commands.start_legacy: (isolated copy) npx astro build && npx astro preview --port 4321
commands.start_target: npm run dev  (or: npm run build && npx vite preview --port 4322)
release_checks: node e2e/run.mjs <outDir> (needs preview on :4322 and local Chrome)

acceptance.visual_tolerances: Familiar layout/terminology/colors; exact pixels not required (no sidebar per user).

notes: Null means unknown, not approval or zero. Discover facts; request consequential missing decisions. Cost is not authorized by a null budget. Session limits are configurable conservative defaults.
